reason: The problem with using traditional assessment systems is that they rely on quizzes, which are not always a true indicator of conceptual understanding, and may obscure the invisible learning gap – when students are doing well while not learning. In this paper, we present Skillo, an adaptive learning platform with integrated AI capabilities designed to identify and bridge these unknown gaps by leveraging a multi-model pipeline that integrates the following models: BERT-based semantic similarity model [13], XGBoost classification model [12], and a Recommender based on RAG. The system features separate teacher and student portals, backed up by FastAPI, MongoDB and FAISS. The model is trained on 2,290 attempts by students from 50 topics and detects semantic and behavioural features of the attempted topics to identify students who have a lack of knowledge and understanding despite being awarded a score. Results show that Skillo provides possibilities for timely personalised interventions and helps to make formative assessment more effective in e-learning contexts.
title: Skillo: A Predictive Artificial Intelligence Framework for Detecting Invisible Learning Gaps in Online Education
